instruction: Use only the pinned native Desktop workflow: Autodesk Revit 2025 file version 25.x, Graphisoft Archicad 27 build 6000 or newer, OpenStudio 3.10.0, and its bundled EnergyPlus 25.1.0. On this machine, the installed entry points are `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe`, `C:\Program Files\GRAPHISOFT\Archicad 27\Archicad.exe`, and `C:\openstudio-3.10.0\bin\openstudio.exe`. Start from C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc and C:\Users\user\Desktop\workflow_spec.json; do not replace the seed or hand-author any delivered IFC, OSM, IDF, SQL, JSON, or CSV. Run exactly these commands in order, requiring each launcher to succeed before starting the next: (1) powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\Users\user\Desktop\run_revit_stage.ps1, (2) powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\Users\user\Desktop\run_archicad_stage.ps1, and (3) powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\Users\user\Desktop\run_openstudio_stage.ps1. Stage 1 must use the supplied task-local Revit IExternalApplication bridge to preserve the real clinic shell and existing Exam room, split only the waiting-side bay with a room-bounding element, create a genuinely bounded RECORDS-ROOM, and export stage1.ifc plus revit_handoff.json. Preserve every seed IfcElement GlobalId, at least 80 percent of seed IfcProduct GlobalIds, and all seed spatial-container GlobalIds; do not introduce placeholder doors, windows, roofs, or geometry-less entities. Stage 2 must use Archicad's IFC command server and archicad_ifc4_translator.json to load stage1.ifc, run Macro.ValidateIfcModel, query the required IFC classes and each space's GlobalId, Name, and LongName from the live model, and save stage2.ifc. Audit the space-boundary relationships actually present in both native files and preserve the observed upstream state; do not fabricate missing relationships or claim second-level boundaries when the files do not contain them. Retain every stage1 IfcRoot GlobalId, reject duplicate GlobalIds, and export archicad_validation_report.json and archicad_handoff.json. Every handoff space row must be keyed by an IfcSpace GlobalId present in the corresponding IFC and include area_m2, storey, thermal_zone, schedule category, people, lighting, equipment, and outdoor-air assumptions. Stage 3 must run the supplied OpenStudio Ruby converter against stage2.ifc and archicad_handoff.json, create separate WAITING-ZN, EXAM-ROOM-ZN, and RECORDS-ROOM-ZN geometry and loads, forward-translate result.osm to in.idf, and execute a real annual EnergyPlus run with weather.epw. Required final artifacts are stage1.ifc, revit_handoff.json, stage2.ifc, archicad_validation_report.json, archicad_handoff.json, native_stage_log.json, workflow.osw, result.osm, in.idf, flow_report.json, model_summary.csv, energy_report.csv, run\eplusout.sql, and run\eplusout.err. Preserve revision EW3B03 and all required tokens in workflow_spec.json. The evaluator parses IFC geometry, quantities, properties, and GlobalIds; verifies Archicad live-query records against the saved IFC; reconciles space and zone areas through the handoffs, OSM, IDF, and CSV; opens standard EnergyPlus SQLite tables; requires a genuine successful termination with no severe or fatal errors; and cross-checks energy against an evaluator-side EnergyPlus rerun. Hashes or self-reported JSON alone are not sufficient.
